subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers treat the reporter's wrapper trace as enough to change OpenClaw's managed Claude CLI auth/runtime behavior, or require a maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent reproduction first?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential state that this read-only review could not safely reproduce.

options.title: Require managed-vs-service proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro that compares gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP config, empty MCP config, and credential state before changing code.

options.title: Patch from source trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted Claude CLI backend/auth change from the reporter's trace, accepting higher risk around auth-env policy because the exact live trigger is still unproven.

options.title: Fold into recovery-copy work only if proven
options.body: Treat this as part of the expired-token re-auth hint cluster only if live proof shows the same expired-token recovery failure rather than a distinct service-context/MCP failure.

recommendation.title: Require managed-vs-service proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent repro that compares gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP config, empty MCP config, and credential state before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history makes this the strongest current owner signal for Anthropic Claude CLI auth/runtime behavior.
